implement_rule_disposition: Envelope versions/job/submission/layer/family/scope/dependencies validated with per-layer scope nullability rules.
Canonical/edition/locale schemas reject wrong-layer fields via strict records objects.
review_status draft literals on package and every record; candidates literal unresolved.
Claim subjects/objects are closed discriminators (entity/scope/text/number/date_range/geometry/controlled) — no unknown anywhere.
Every claim requires >=1 citation resolving to a defined citation record.
Citations carry only evidence_item_key checked against the injected job set; url/path/locator/rights/digest fields cannot exist (strict rejection proven by test).
proposed_label never consulted by the resolver (proven by test); candidates stay unresolved without a trusted reconciliation record.
Full cross-record battery with pointers for all 13 key families.
Grouped coverage enforced against injected authority: gaps, overlaps, contradictory complete_zero, missing records, blocked-without-questions all rejected.
Language/canon/refsys/edition validated against injected snapshots only; zero hard-coded registries in code.
Legacy 20F dangling pattern proven unpassable with the offending keys named.
judgment_calls: Two-tier resolution: references resolve to same-package definitions or injected approved sets; unresolved-at-draft is an error (not a pending list), keeping the gate binary and fail-closed.
Reconciliation records live in canonical packages as optional (examples carry none); decided statuses require the key, undecided forbid it.
Empty record groups allowed structurally; coverage membership makes emptiness claims honest.
Attestation/mention/context/profile/localization links across layers resolve only through injected approved sets — enforcing the dependency chain by construction.
